contracts.source: Onto Innovation press release: Onto Innovation Receives Best Partner Award from SK hynix (10-12-2026)
contracts.signal: Onto states SK hynix recognized it at its 25th Anniversary Partners Day (September 28, 2026; an annual ceremony honoring supplier contributions) for developing a defect prevention system with measurement technology for HBM applications, citing Onto's contribution to SK hynix's HBM roadmap. Onto's Dragonfly G5 inspection system provides the process control to identify critical defects earlier, helping SK hynix reduce the risk of yield loss in HBM devices. CEO Mike Plisinski: the result of close collaboration between SK hynix and Onto's product and customer success teams to help identify hidden yield-impacting defects critical to reliable HBM manufacturing.
